name: KPI & Analytics {OS}
tagline: Measure the few numbers that actually change decisions.

commands.name: /kpi-select
commands.summary: Choose the few numbers that change decisions, and the stop-tracking list.

commands.name: /kpi-define
commands.summary: Make a metric computable by a stranger, with explicit counting rules.

commands.name: /kpi-threshold
commands.summary: Attach the threshold and the decision it triggers, agreed before the first reading.

commands.name: /kpi-instrument
commands.summary: State what must be captured, and hand the requirement to Automation {OS}.

commands.name: /kpi-read
commands.summary: Run the reading cycle, separating real movement from normal variation.

commands.name: /kpi-decide
commands.summary: Present the pre-agreed decision on a crossed threshold to its owner.

commands.name: /kpi-audit
commands.summary: Judge the set on the decisions each metric actually changed.

commands.name: /kpi-reconcile
commands.summary: Settle two sources reporting the same quantity, and name the authoritative one.

requires_human_approval_for: changing a metric definition that has history attached to it
retiring a metric anyone is currently reporting or being measured on
publishing a metric that measures an individual's performance
setting a threshold that automatically triggers a consequential action
sharing internal metrics outside the organisation
